args.fix: Replaced read-modify-write with single atomic UPDATEs: deposit uses UPDATE ... SET balance = balance + %s, withdraw uses UPDATE ... SET balance = balance - %s WHERE balance >= %s and disambiguates unknown-account vs insufficient-funds with a follow-up SELECT. Row-level write locks serialize concurrent updates to the same account while different accounts proceed in parallel.
args.root_cause: Both deposit() and withdraw() did SELECT balance then UPDATE balance=<old>+/-amount without locking (no FOR UPDATE). Two concurrent transactions read the same old balance and the second overwrote the first, losing one update, so final balances were less than the sum of successful operations.

text: Fix accepted. Root cause was a lost-update race: `deposit`/`withdraw` did `SELECT balance` then `UPDATE balance=<old>±amount` without row locking, so concurrent transactions overwrote each other. Fixed with single atomic `UPDATE ... SET balance = balance ± %s` (conditional on `balance >= %s` for withdraws), preserving exact sequential semantics while serializing only same-row writes.
